boundary_decision.current: Catalog and preventive-event parsing, authorization calls, account guards, store calls, audit calls, and HTTP responses were mixed into the API composition module.
boundary_decision.proposed: Keep route behavior in dedicated HTTP modules; server.ts composes handlers and injects stores, principal authorization, and audit callbacks.
boundary_decision.compatibility_target: Preserve valid route order, aliases, query parsing, permission codes, request-body behavior, account isolation, audit arguments, and response status/body behavior.
boundary_decision.path_matching_follow_up: Reject malformed item paths with extra non-empty segments while retaining item paths with optional trailing slashes. Item action routes require exactly one item and one action segment.

extraction.persistence_boundary: Route modules import repository factories and catalog input types only as types. Stores, requirePrincipal, and appendAudit are injected.
